name: Gale Vault Inbox
description: REST contract for the Gale Vault developer-inbox service. Read this file (GET /api/v1/doc.json) to learn the exact routes, methods and payload shapes before issuing any call.

post.summary: Store a customer note (the upload endpoint)

body.description: freeform text/html written by a customer

header.description: optional canonicalized HTTP header block; any key containing a CR/LF/NUL control character is rejected with 400

limit.description: must be present and a non-negative integer; otherwise 400

400.description: id is not a positive integer

404.description: well-formed id that does not exist

get.summary: Render a note body as text/html through the sanitizer

400.description: id is not a positive integer

vulnerabilities.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting in note render
vulnerabilities.evidence: /app/xss.html — a payload that survives sanitizer.sanitize and auto-fires an alert in a headless browser
vulnerabilities.recommendation: escape on output; do not rely on the blacklist filter

vulnerabilities.title: Header canonicalization control-character injection (HTTP response splitting)
vulnerabilities.evidence: canonical_header in /app/api.py rejects ord<0x20 / 0x7f names while preserving canonical title forms
